newsitem.title: CHINA: China considers liquidatation of idle assets.
newsitem.headline: China considers liquidatation of idle assets.

text.p: China is considering the liquidation of 130 billion yuan ($15.7 billion) worth of idle assets owned by government departments and non-profit organizations, Shanghai's Business News said on Wednesday.

According to a survey, China's 460,000 administrative departments and non-profit oriented units had fixed assets of 862.9 billion yuan in 1996, of which 15 to 20 percent were idle, the newspaper said.
Around 30 percent of such idle assets could be liquidated, bringing 11.7 billion yuan in returns, it said.
The funds could be re-injected into these units to upgrade technology and reduce their dependency on the government, the newspaper said.
